# Security policy

Security fixes target the latest release. Backports to older releases are not
guaranteed.

Report vulnerabilities privately to [shemtorga@gmail.com](mailto:shemtorga@gmail.com).
Please do not post an exploit or secret key in a public issue or pull request.

Include the affected version or commit, enabled features, steps to reproduce,
and the expected impact. A small reproducer using test keys is helpful.
